reason: I already have a GitHub Action that runs claude -p every night and opens PRs. Drawing the pipeline in a GUI doesn't buy me much over a YAML file I control.
objection: It's pre-alpha from one developer, and I'd be swapping a script I understand for a whole new system my team has to learn and trust with our repos.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it handle retries, approval gates and the phone decision list much better than my script on a real repo, so I'd use the free self-hosted version first.
